text_markup: To {term:break} a subroutine is to change its status with respect to the active encounter from unbroken to broken. Many cards that can allow a player to break subroutines are icebreakers (see {ref:subsec_icebreakers}). If the Runner breaks all the subroutines on the encountered ice, they fully break that ice (see {ref:subsec_fully_break}).
text_plain: To break a subroutine is to change its status with respect to the active encounter from unbroken to broken. Many cards that can allow a player to break subroutines are icebreakers (see section 3.9.5). If the Runner breaks all the subroutines on the encountered ice, they fully break that ice (see section 6.5.7).
